title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary: Fixed empty hexagonal column 3D preview in forms. Flow eval runs in a dedicated worker WASM context, so geometry handles from evaluate() are invalid on the main-thread BRep bridge. Flow3dQuestionControl now calls client.tessellatePreviews() after evaluate and attaches meshes via new attachPreviewMeshesToItems() (same pattern as procedural play + FlowCanvas). Added relative positioning on the preview container. forms-react tests pass.
